statement: At SDL 3.4.18 PS5 HIDAPI, genuine Sony identity is treated as sensor-capable; gyro is registered when enhanced mode is available and sensors are supported. Enabling requires a compatible enhanced-mode state, and SDL requests calibration feature 0x05, but a short/invalid calibration reply does not hard-disable sensors: it retains an uncalibrated conversion path. Sony feature 0x09 pairing identity and 0x20 firmware reads support enhanced-report/Bluetooth initialization and firmware behavior but their failure does not directly imply no gyro if enhanced input reporting works. Input packet framing, report stream and sensor-enable state remain independently necessary.

applicability.revision: HHD adbd50ff and SDL 3.4.18 compatibility source, no independent DualSense hardware comparison
applicability.scope: evidence_role: consumer. SDL PS5 405-470 report detection, pairing/firmware, capabilities; 591-703 calibration fallback; 835-885 gyro registration; 1156-1172 enable; 1360-1408 IMU dispatch. No installed HHD+SDL run.
